description: We are a team that wants to share information in a visual way that gets people's attention. We want to do this with video games and comics about the history of space technology.This technology is very important for space knowledge. We don't only want to show its big contribution to human progress. We also want to show its story from the beginning: the first idea, the people who created it together, and some of the trials and errors they made to make it work well.
